name: inkkit
description: Self-contained device layer for Xteink X4/X3 (ESP32-C3) e-ink firmware: thin inkkit:: wrappers over a vendored HAL (adapted from CrossPoint Reader, MIT) and the vendored FreeInk SDK hardware libraries (MIT). One lib_deps line gives an app display/partial-refresh, SD streaming, button input, config persistence and power management. Build with -DINKKIT_HAL_STUB for a hardware-free compile-and-link stub of the same API.
